text:
eli: seeing a spike in 'nvme-io-queueing' errors across eu-west3 after a big batch rollout. GPU attaches failing with 'no scratch slots'. anyone oncall?
patch-bot: ALERT: eu-west3-local-nvme io_util > 94% for 7m. attach_failures 9%.
nina: i'm looking. iops per node spiked ~x5. traces show janitor trim+deep-scrub started at same minute as autoscaler bringing up 200 nodes. scrub jitter appears disabled here.
eli: that explains fanout. we patched jitter off last week for debugging and forgot to re-enable it.
oscar: quick mitigation: throttle janitor threads and gate attaches to nodes with free_scratch_slots>=5. also set scrub_backoff_if_attach_queue>30.
eli: can you patch and post commands?
oscar: running:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1","scrubJitter":"900"}}'
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"expr":"free_scratch_slots>=5"}'
```
patch-bot: CHANGE applied by oscar at 4299002490. automated rollback at 4299002890 if attach_error_rate increases.
nina: canary shows attach queue drop 138->18 in 45s. iops falling, latencies improving.
eli: please follow up with retrospective item: add pre-scale check that prevents janitor windows overlapping scale events. owner: infra/scheduling.
oscar: noted. reopening runbook to add an automatic scrub-jitter enforcement rule.
eli: thanks. keep this thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
